purpose: Validate importing a confirmed Reference entity bundle into a short-film project, preserving exact source revisions and asset bytes, then exercise shot-level preview, retry/history, and assembly.

source_entity.name: 一期验收 · 四图概念探索

generation.plan: Two independently rendered shots (visual setup; spoken shot using the confirmed voice sample with NativeAudioLock), one S02 retry branch, then assemble selected candidates. No model comparison or model swap was performed.

qc.visual_review: Keyframes inspected for all three candidates. Identity, costume and sheathed katana remain recognizable. Both greeting candidates are usable; A has framing closer to the prompt.
qc.audio_review: All outputs contain AAC stereo at 32 kHz. S02 audio duration is 6.575 s versus the 6.08 s source WAV. NativeAudioLock input and exact source dialogue were used. Sample-level equality was not verified; audio listening could not be performed in this environment.
qc.assembly: outputs/assembled_preview_S01_A_S02_A.mp4; H.264 1024x576 24 fps; video 11.041667 s; audio 11.065344 s; stream-copy concat.
